title: Fire-Retardant Grill Mat – Protects Ground & Deck
descriptionHtml:
Grill with confidence – no burn marks

Sparks and grease from the grill easily leave ugly marks on the deck, lawn and patio. Burn marks in wooden decking are hard to remove.

A protective mat under the grill

This grill mat is made of fire-retardant fiberglass material that withstands high heat. It protects the surface from sparks and grease and can be used again and again.

Features

  • Fire-retardant fiberglass material
  • Withstands high heat
  • Protects deck, lawn and patio
  • Reusable and easy to roll up
  • Good for grill, fire pit and picnic

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
